final:
Done — archived **#delta-ops**.

It was the only channel that fit: your owner (Nina Torres) belongs to it, it's the most recently created of her channels, and it had exactly four human members (Nina, Diego, Leo, and Omar — the 5th "member" in Slack's API count is our bot agent, which I didn't count as a person).

Verified post-archive: `delta-ops` now shows as archived. If that was the wrong interpretation (e.g., you wanted the most recent channel *overall* with exactly 4 members — `#random-chat` has 3, so it wouldn't qualify anyway), just say the word.
